_doc: How each kind of planet is drawn in the battle (src/Game/View/PlanetLooks.cs, read into src/Game/View/planet.gdshader and planet_atmosphere.gdshader; owner, 2026-11-08: "In game Planets: pull in planets from godot-sandbox and falchion"). One look per PlanetDef.Kinds. Ported from Falchion's PLANET_LOOKS (RubenTipparach/falchion 5d128af8, src/content/planetLooks.ts): surface is rocky (noise terrain with seas, caps, craters and canyons), gas (warped bands and a storm) or lava (rocky with glowing cracks); palette is deep water, shallow water, lowland, highland for rocky and lava worlds, three bands and the storm for gas; sea is the terrain height (-1 to 1) below which it is liquid (below -1: none); ice_lat the latitude share (0 to 1) where the caps begin (above 1: none); clouds the cover, 0 to 1; detail the noise frequency (more, smaller continents); craters and canyons the landforms; glow the colour of lava and volcanoes; city_glow and cities the night side's lights and how much land they cover (0 to 1); volcanoes adds cones with lit calderas. The atmosphere shell is godot-sandbox's single scattering shell (RubenTipparach/godot-sandbox 63f463f7, resources/shaders/comic_atmosphere_shell.gdshader): atmosphere its tint, atmosphere_strength how strongly it scatters (0: no shell), atmosphere_height its top as a share of the radius above the ground.
